preflight_dedup.reason: P014 already models cargo execution as a stateful ship-terminal-cargo-equipment interface, while P129/P130/P133/P134/P135 cover transfer, storage, landside handoff, measurement/custody and workforce states. A bounded integrated cargo-operation readiness and dependency-alignment layer may still be useful, but most monitoring, support, constraint, lifecycle and propagation abstractions are expected duplicates or refinements.

new_categories.label: integrated_terminal_cargo_operation_readiness
new_categories.memory: A terminal cargo movement can require a bounded integrated readiness state across berth/vessel interface, transfer path, storage/reclaim, landside handoff, measurement/custody and workforce coverage rather than assuming that isolated component readiness automatically composes into executable service.

new_categories.label: cross_interface_dependency_alignment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence can attach to whether the required interfaces are mutually aligned for the same bounded cargo-operation scope, without retaining exact plans, sequences, windows, rates or control-room logic.

new_categories.label: readiness_composition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Integrated readiness is not necessarily a simple minimum, sum or all-green conjunction of component states; composition can remain an explicit qualitative confidence judgment.

new_categories.label: limiting_interface_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: A bounded operation may be constrained by one or more interfaces, but the limiting scope should be represented without inferring a universal bottleneck or exact throughput effect.

new_categories.label: cross_interface_continuity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Continuity across sequential or coupled terminal interfaces can degrade even when each interface has some local availability, without preserving exact operating sequence.

new_categories.label: change_propagation_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: A change or restriction in one interface can propagate into other readiness states, but propagation should be scope-bounded and should not turn downstream effects into proof of the originating cause.

new_categories.label: cross_interface_temporal_alignment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Component readiness may occur at different times; integrated service can depend on sufficient temporal alignment without retaining exact windows, slots or schedules.

new_categories.label: integrated_readiness_monitoring_indication_confidence
new_categories.memory: A synthesized readiness view or indication can be uncertain even when component observations exist, without retaining exact dashboards, controls or decision-support systems.

new_categories.label: integrated_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Shared support dependencies can affect several interfaces at once, but exact dependency topology, provider identity and control logic remain deferred.

new_categories.label: integrated_scoped_constraint_confidence
new_categories.memory: Integrated operation can be available for one bounded cargo movement or interface combination while restricted for another; restriction should remain scoped rather than collapsed to terminal-wide availability.

new_categories.label: integrated_degradation_restriction_restoration_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Integrated readiness can move through available, degraded, restricted, unavailable for a bounded scope, under-restoration and restored states while component states recover asynchronously.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_integrated_restoration
new_categories.memory: Transfer, storage, handoff, measurement and workforce recovery can occur at different times, so integrated readiness restoration should not be represented by one synthetic timestamp.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_integrated_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Congestion, reduced throughput, rehandling, berth delay or schedule effects do not by themselves prove which integrated interface caused the constraint.

useful_refinements.label: integrated_readiness_vs_stateful_execution_P014
useful_refinements.memory: P014 establishes physical cargo execution as a stateful interface; P136 tests whether an explicit pre-execution/in-operation integrated readiness layer across multiple terminal services adds durable semantics beyond that broad execution state.

useful_refinements.label: integrated_readiness_vs_transfer_storage_states_P129_P130
useful_refinements.memory: Transfer-path and storage/reclaim readiness are necessary inputs but do not individually establish that the full bounded cargo movement can proceed.

useful_refinements.label: integrated_readiness_vs_landside_measurement_workforce_P133_P134_P135
useful_refinements.memory: Landside handoff, measurement/custody and workforce coverage can each be available while mutual scope or timing alignment remains uncertain.

useful_refinements.label: propagation_without_root_cause_inference
useful_refinements.memory: Cross-interface propagation refines the campaign-wide causal-boundary rule: downstream operational effects can narrow the affected scope but cannot by themselves identify the initiating interface.

duplicates.label: generic_monitoring_support_availability_degradation_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic monitoring, support dependency, availability, degradation, restriction and restoration mechanics repeat prior terminal/service-state families.

duplicates.label: component_readiness_categories_already_owned_by_prior_passes
duplicates.memory: Transfer, storage, landside, measurement/custody and workforce readiness categories are already owned by P129/P130/P133/P134/P135 and are not new merely because they appear in an integrated view.

stop_reason: The bounded integrated terminal-readiness questions are answered at structural Memory level. Most additional recall collapses into already-owned component service states or exact operating plans, sequences, windows, capacities, controls and procedures that require Evidence. The thin surviving synthesis layer should be heavily campaign-wide de-duplicated before any durable novelty claim.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive integrated port-terminal cargo-operation readiness orientation and source-discovery output; not terminal planning, scheduling, optimization, dispatch, control-room, maintenance, troubleshooting or emergency guidance and not proof of any exact plan, sequence, window, capacity, rate, control, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
